subsidiaries.name: Deepak Phenolics Ltd (DPL)
subsidiaries.what: Cumene-phenol-acetone-IPA complex at Dahej; licensed ~300 ktpa phenol, 180 ktpa acetone, 81 ktpa IPA; >50% India share in phenol and acetone; FY25 revenue ₹5,863 cr, PAT ₹591 cr

subsidiaries.name: Deepak Chem Tech Ltd (DCTL)
subsidiaries.what: Growth vehicle: nitric acid (Nandesari), nitration and hydrogenation (Dahej), fluorination/photochlorination, MIBK/MIBC, multipurpose agro-intermediates, and the ₹11,500 cr cumene-to-polycarbonate project

ai.name: Advanced Intermediates
ai.products: Sodium nitrite/nitrate, nitro-toluidines, xylidines, cumidines, oximes, optical brightening agents (OBA), DASDA, fuel additives; nitric acid (captive), nitration, hydrogenation, fluorination (e.g. benzotrifluoride), photochlorination products
ai.customers: Dyes and pigments, agrochemicals, pharma, rubber, paper, water treatment; ~40-50% exported
ai.position: India's largest sodium nitrite maker; top-3 globally in xylidines and oximes; largest OBA maker outside China (management)

ph.name: Phenolics
ph.products: Cumene, phenol, acetone, isopropyl alcohol (IPA), alpha-methyl styrene; MIBK/MIBC and acetophenone being added
ph.customers: Laminates and plywood, adhesives, pharma, agrochemicals, automotive, construction; almost entirely domestic
ph.position: >50% India market share in phenol and acetone; largest IPA capacity in India

fy26.note: Company EBITDA includes other income (₹60 cr); Screener EBITDA (₹987 cr) excludes it. Exceptional = ₹12.84 cr gratuity provision under the new Labour Codes (Q3FY26). Revenue and PBT exclude ₹91 cr standalone dividend income from subsidiaries (FY25: ₹98 cr).

q1fy27.text: Highest-ever revenue, EBITDA, PBT and PAT. Phenolics helped by 'favourable product spreads, firm domestic realisations'; AI by better realisations, product mix and backward integration.
Government removed the import duty on phenol for practically all of Q1 (nil duty 2-Apr to 30-Jun-2026 under Notification 12/2026-Customs); management says it has since been reimposed.
Run-rate close to 1 lakh tonnes a quarter at times in Q1; ~₹70 cr more debottlenecking to reach ~4 lakh tpa at DPL (₹80-100 cr spent so far taking it from ~2 lakh t).
Management declines to comment on spreads; says it buys feedstock and sells above international index levels.
Group CFO: 'no new capacities are coming up… there is a short supply today.'

Asked whether Q1 had inventory gains: 'I don't think there was any place where we were able to get any benefit.' (In May, management said it had built feedstock stocks 'at enviable prices' that would last until about mid-Q2.)

MIBK, MIBC and acetophenone to be commissioned in August 2026; alkylation and multipurpose agro-intermediates plants slipped a couple of months (contract labour and gas shortages in Q1), commercial volumes from January 2027.

₹11,500 cr propylene-to-polycarbonate programme funded 60:40 debt:equity; all debt tied up. ~₹1,200 cr spent; ₹1,500-1,600 cr more in FY27; ~₹3,000 cr in 2027-28. PC commissioning targeted H2 FY28-29 (PL: H2FY29), BPA a few months later. Peak borrowing ~₹8,000-8,500 cr incl. working capital; debt/equity 'will not cross even 1'.
AI is ~50:50 domestic:export; Phenolics almost entirely domestic; consolidated ~80:20 to 85:15.

q4fy26.text: New nitric acid plant (commissioned 4-Dec-2025, ~₹515 cr) ran at only ~45% in Q4 because of technical problems; balance bought from the market at high prices.
Bought benzene, toluene, xylene 'at every dip' from late January as the Middle East tension built; entered Q1 with 'a much larger inventory' at 'enviable prices' lasting until about mid-Q2.
China announced (Dec-2025) tighter controls on hazardous chemistries incl. nitration; management sees a structural tailwind for nitration products, already 'started happening'.
Polycarbonate expected to be commissioned by June 2028 (PL: revised from Dec-2027).
₹11,000-11,500 cr funded 60:40 debt:equity; 'as and when required, if at all required, we'll approach the market.'
'In FY27 we expect a stronger margin profile, even for the standalone business, compared with FY26.'

q3fy26.text: AI revenue fell from ~₹3,000 cr (FY23) to a ~₹2,400 cr run-rate: 'a substantial amount of this is because of pricing, not so much because of volume', due to Chinese oversupply.
US anti-dumping duty on Indian sodium nitrite cut from ~45-48% to essentially zero; reciprocal tariff 18% vs 50% earlier. DN historically exported ~5,000 t a year to the US.
Produced its 2-millionth tonne of phenol on 13-Feb-2026.
India imports >300,000 t a year of polycarbonate resin (vs ~2 lakh t estimated 1-1.5 years earlier).

accounting.text: Deepak Phenolics books a State of Gujarat GST incentive ('Incentive to Industries (General) 2016-2021') as revenue: ₹161 cr in FY25 (all in Q4FY25), ₹102 cr in FY26 (₹68 cr in Q4FY26), ₹21.5 cr in Q1FY27. Incentive receivable ₹51.5 cr at Mar-2026.
₹12.84 cr Labour Code gratuity provision in Q3FY26 (AI ₹11.31 cr, Phenolics ₹1.53 cr).
